sloka: बलस्य परिमाणम् च द्वार दुर्ग क्रियाम् अपि ।गुप्ति कर्म च लंकाया रक्षसाम् सदनानि च ॥६-३-४॥।।
transliteration: balasya parimāṇam ca dvāra durga kriyām api ।gupti karma ca laṁkāyā rakṣasām sadanāni ca ॥6-3-4॥।।

translations.english: "Tell me in detail about the strength and size of the army, the number of gateways that are difficult to enter, the way in which the entrances have been protected by the rakshasas, and their dwellings in Lanka. Indeed you are aware of all aspects and are also capable."
